what: research-queue-dispatch.yml 'Check for an in-flight receipt PR' (l.543-550) skips EVERY receipt landing while any automation/research-queue-receipt* PR is open, with no staleness or mergeability test. PR #17702 sat open+dirty from 2026-10-12T07:52Z, so the receipt on main stayed at 2026-10-12T07:12Z (43.5h old at 2026-10-14T02:47Z; check_research_queue_dispatch_liveness.py trips at 48h and then pages). research-ops closed #17702 this pass (the unblock); the workflow is unchanged, so the same wedge recurs the next time a receipt PR goes dirty. Fix: when the in-flight receipt PR is mergeable_state=dirty or older than N hours, close it and proceed with the new landing (the receipt json is overwritten by the next landing, so closing loses nothing).
